column1: # KB-28 — the framesize predicates key on the TRUE CROP, not the mi-aligned extent. 2026-08-02

# host         Apple M4 Pro, Darwin 25.5.0 arm64
# build        cargo test --profile test-fast -j 4, default dispatch (aarch64 NEON live)
# content      mirror-tiled first KEY frame of av1-1-b8-00-quantizer-00, bd8 4:2:0,
#              ALLINTRA usage=2, single KEY frame, 1 tile, stock knobs
# reference    real libaom aom_codec_av1_cx via aom-sys-ref; compared unit is the frame-OBU payload
#   post                       = the landed fix (SbEncodeEnv::frame_{width,height} threaded to all
#   revert-vbp-numpixels       = bite proof A: pack.rs's VBP `num_pixels` back to the mi-aligned
#                                area + the old crop-ambiguity assert. Everything else landed.
#   revert-mindim-predicates   = bite proof B: partition_pick.rs's four AOMMIN(w,h) consumers back

# B fails only the cpu 1..6 min-dim band. Same root (the walk had no crop dims), different
# Geometry per shape (crop -> mi-aligned, and what each reading says):
#   1280x720 -> 1280x720   area 921600 == R720 both; old guard FIRED anyway (1277*717 < R720)
#   1272x724 -> 1272x728   crop area 920928 < R720 <= mi 925856; old guard FIRED
#   1288x716 -> 1288x720   areas agree; min-dim 716 < 720 <= mi 720; old guard FIRED
#   1274x722 -> 1280x728   crop area 919828 < R720 <= mi 931840; old guard SILENT (the hole)
#   954x962  -> 960x968    crop area 917748 < R720 <= mi 929280; old guard SILENT (the hole)
#   1280x704 / 1216x768    controls, mi == crop AND multiples of 64 (SB-exact)
#   250x250  -> 256x256    KB-23's row: CNN window only; both readings are sub-480p
#   before KB-28: 26/28, the two non-matches being 1280x720 cq{24,40} cpu7 = PANIC
#   after  KB-28: 28/28 byte-exact; LARGE_FRAME_OPEN is now EMPTY
# --- Residual at cpu 8/9 (NOT KB-28's — see CLAUDE.md KB-28 "RESIDUAL"). ---

# (1280x720 cq24, -132 B over 240 SB). The SB-exact controls 1280x704 and 1216x768
